info.bio:
La historia de Supertramp se inicia en 1969. El teclista Rick Davies (nacido en Gran Bretaña en 1944) se hallaba tocando con el grupo Joint, y estaba arruinado, cuando la suerte llamó a su puerta en forma de un apasionado del rock, que reconoció en él las dotes de una estrella de rock y se ofreció para financiar su carrera.
Davies regresó a Londres para probar nuevos músicos y crear un grupo llamado provisionalmente Daddy. Uno de los elegidos fue el poliinstrumentista Roger Hodgson (nacido en 1950).

scenes.name: Techno-rock y pop de estudio
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El «sonido» por encima de la melodía, el ritmo y la armonía: Electric Light Orchestra inventa el «high-tech pop»; Supertramp, Alan Parsons Project, Kansas, Styx y Split Enz. El valor de la producción define a Steely Dan (el pop-jazz pulido de los yuppies), Hall & Oates, los Fleetwood Mac de Rumours y Tusk, Toto, el «muro de sonido» titánico de Jim Steinman (Bat Out Of Hell) y la Penguin Cafe Orchestra. A finales de los setenta, el art-rock culmina en los supergrupos: 10cc, Godley & Creme, Foreigner, UK, Asia, Sky.

mentions.author: Piero Scaruffi
mentions.text: …and A New World Record (1976), led to the tour de force of Out of the Blue (1977) the same way the Beatles' Sgt Pepper led to the White Album. Supertramp (1) were even more original in blending Yes' pomp-rock, Led Zeppelin's hard-rock, Beach Boys' vocal harmonies, EL&P's neo-classical rock,…

podcast.title: Fascination for Young Trent Reznor
podcast.body: As a child, Trent Reznor was fascinated by Supertramp, among other bands, contributing to his early musical interests and development. "He was fascinated by super tramp Pink Floyd and anything that had to do with the Antichrist."

podcast.title: Pushing for Better Sound
podcast.body: Supertramp was among the bands, including David Bowie and Yes, who actively pushed sound companies to improve their live audio. They considered "getting concert sound right was very, very important," thereby influencing the advancement of concert sound systems and techniques. "But to performers like David Bowie and Yes and Super Tramp, getting concert sound right was very, very important, so they pushed sound companies to get better."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Musical Beginnings and Influences
xref.body: Trent began piano lessons at age five and later learned to play the tuba and saxophone in the school band. He was fascinated by bands like Supertramp and Pink Floyd, as well as anything related to the Antichrist. His primary inspiration for becoming a musician, surprisingly, came from synth-driven bands like The Human League, OMD, and Depeche Mode, which he found "really cool" compared to punk bands like the Sex Pistols, The Clash, and The Ramones. "The piano lesson started at age five. He learned to play the tuba and the saxophone in the school band."

xref.title: Notable Clients and Albums
xref.body: Over its decade of operation, AIR Montserrat hosted many major artists, including Bush, Elton John, Supertramp, The Rolling Stones, Pink Floyd, Duran Duran, Black Sabbath, Paul McCartney, and Dire Straits. Albums like *Brothers in Arms*, *Ghosts in the Machine*, and *Synchronicity* were recorded there. "Bush, Elton Johns, Super Tramp, The Rolling Stones, Pink Floyd, Durand Durand, Black Sabbath, Paul McCartney, Dire Straits, they all went to Air Studios Montserrat."

xref.title: Pushing for Better Sound
xref.body: David Bowie was among the artists, including Yes and Supertramp, who placed great importance on achieving high-quality concert sound. Their insistence "pushed sound companies to get better," contributing to advancements in live audio technology and services. "But to performers like David Bowie and Yes and Super Tramp, getting concert sound right was very, very important, so they pushed sound companies to get better."
